previewNotice: These controls demonstrate the user interface; they are not connected to live audio yet.
speaker: USB speakers
routingNotice: Read-only device counts; they do not confirm audible playback.
routingRecent: Status retrieved within the last 15 seconds
routingRecheckRequested: Status recheck requested. See the current result above.
routingHistoryNote: At most eight sanitized changes observed on this page are also included in the diagnostic JSON download. Times come from your browser. This is not proof of sound or hardware acceptance; reloading clears the history.
routingCompareNote: Choose a previous AudioHub v4 JSON report from this device (maximum 64 KiB). It is read only in this browser, never uploaded. Compare sanitized routing counts with fresh live status and human hearing notes with current selections; neither establishes audible playback or hardware approval.
routingCompareObservationsNote: Compare what was manually marked in the earlier report with your current selections above. These are not sound measurements or hardware approval. Missing or invalid earlier notes appear as unavailable.
routingCompareInvalid: Unsupported, unavailable, or invalid v4 report. No values imported.
routingCompareTooLarge: Report is larger than 64 KiB or has an invalid file size.
routingCompareReady: Earlier routing values are compared with recent live status; self-reported listening notes are compared separately. Neither is proof of sound.
routingCompareCurrentUnavailable: Earlier report loaded; current device status unavailable, so routing differences cannot be calculated. Manual listening notes can still be compared.
routingDiagPending: Diagnostic guidance will appear after the first status check.
routingDiagUnavailable: No recent device report. Check whether the local AudioHub status service is running.
routingDiagUsbMissing: USB speakers not detected. Check the USB connection to your Raspberry Pi.
routingDiagNoChannels: No virtual input channels reported. Check whether AudioHub audio services are running.
routingDiagNoRoutes: No active audio routes reported. Check the input connections and audio services.
routingDiagNoBluetooth: No Bluetooth sources reported. Other audio input types may still be active.
routingDiagCountsAvailable: Input counts are available. Audible playback still needs a manual sound check.
routingExportRequested: Download requested. Check your browser's downloads.
routingExportUnavailable: Report download unavailable in this browser.
routingObservationsNote: Record what you personally heard during an isolated test. These unverified selections exist only on this page (reloading resets them) and do not approve the hardware or a release. The exported timestamp comes from your browser clock.
routingObservationsCleared: All manual sound observations reset to Not tested.
copyright: Open-source audio mixing for Raspberry Pi.
sourceHint1: Mixer input 1 · source assignment on the Pi is not shown here
sourceHint2: Mixer input 2 · LAN and Bluetooth sources can use different slots
sourceHint3: Mixer input 3 · Bluetooth support awaits hardware verification
invalidInputName: Choose a distinct name (1–32 characters; no control or markup characters).
previewNamesOnly: Saved for this browser only. Device routing remains unchanged.
routingPlanNotice: Browser-only example. Choose the mixer input for LAN and up to two unnamed Bluetooth sources. This cannot read or change real assignments, pairing or sound.
routingPlanValid: Valid example layout. No device configuration has changed.
routingPlanConflict: Conflict: two sources cannot use the same mixer input. Choose distinct inputs.
routingPlanResetDone: Example restored. Device routing was not changed.
routingGuideComparisonNotice: The current layout is inferred only from YOUR selected old slots, not read from the Pi. Verify source identities locally. An audio interruption may occur even with one policy change.
routingGuideTitle: Prepare a local read-only route preview
routingGuideIntro: For existing manual LAN plus two Bluetooth assignments only. Verify both CURRENT Bluetooth input slots at the authorized Pi terminal first. This browser cannot identify real sources.
routingGuideInspect: First inspect the Pi's private routing: python3 -m audiohub.source_routes --format text slots
routingGuideFromBt1: Current input of Bluetooth source A (verified locally)
routingGuideFromBt2: Current input of Bluetooth source B (verified locally)
routingGuideNeedSlots: No command yet: select both distinct, verified current Bluetooth inputs and all three distinct target inputs.
routingGuideReady: Read-only local preview command prepared. Compare source identities and revision on the Pi before any separate action.
routingGuideCommandLabel: Read-only local preview command (copy manually; never executed here)
routingGuideWarning: The command only asks for a local read-only preview. It does not verify Bluetooth identities, connect, pair, change routes or authorize a change. Verify the actual source policy and separately review the private revision.
routingPlanScope: Actual Pi routing remains private and unavailable to this page. An authorized local terminal, read-only revision preview and separate confirmation are needed for real changes. Bluetooth placeholders are not trusted device identities.
sustainabilityDescription: Your voluntary support helps fund Pi hardware tests, security improvements, accessibility, and maintenance.
sustainabilityDisclosure: Donations are optional. AudioHub stays available under AGPL-3.0; a donation does not purchase a commercial license or priority support.
